translation:
If the lumbar vertebrae are injured and dislocated, the flesh of the back is torn, and the sinews are oblique and the person is bent forward, use vinegar to mix the Dingtong Powder (定痛散) and apply it to the waist pillar; according to the affected place, arrange the pillars on both sides of the spine bone, and make sure they are upright. Then use Qi ai (蘄艾, mugwort) to make a thin mattress and cover the pillars, to ward off wind and cold. Use a wide and long cloth band, wind it around to the front of the abdomen, and bind it tightly. Internally take medicines and food, and regulate and treat; then it will heal by itself. [Figure: Diagram of the waist pillar 5]
[Figure: Diagram of the use of the waist pillar 6]
<ins>Bamboo curtain (竹簾)</ins> (Instrument 8) The bamboo curtain is the summer cooling curtain; cut it according to the size, length, and width of the affected place. Explanation of use: Whenever a limb has a broken place, first use the manual technique to set it in place, then wrap it with cloth, and then surround the cloth with the bamboo curtain and bind it tightly, so that there is no affliction of the bone seams being uneven or shifting. It is a universally used object.
